# Dependências nativas

Inventário dos manifests resolvidos em Cargo.lock. Core e host headless não têm dependências externas.

|---|---|---|---|
| gdextension-api | 0.5.1 | MPL-2.0 | https://github.com/godot-rust/gdext |
| glam | 0.32.1 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/bitshifter/glam-rs |
| godot | 0.5.5 | MPL-2.0 | https://github.com/godot-rust/gdext |
| godot-bindings | 0.5.5 | MPL-2.0 | https://github.com/godot-rust/gdext |
| godot-cell | 0.5.5 | MPL-2.0 | https://github.com/godot-rust/gdext |
| godot-codegen | 0.5.5 | MPL-2.0 | https://github.com/godot-rust/gdext |
| godot-core | 0.5.5 | MPL-2.0 | https://github.com/godot-rust/gdext |
| godot-ffi | 0.5.5 | MPL-2.0 | https://github.com/godot-rust/gdext |
| godot-macros | 0.5.5 | MPL-2.0 | https://github.com/godot-rust/gdext |
| heck | 0.5.0 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/withoutboats/heck |
| libc | 0.2.189 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/rust-lang/libc |
| nanoserde | 0.2.1 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/not-fl3/nanoserde |
| nanoserde-derive | 0.2.1 | MIT | registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index |

| quote | 1.0.47 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/dtolnay/quote |
| unicode-ident | 1.0.26 | (MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND Unicode-3.0 | https://github.com/dtolnay/unicode-ident |
| venial | 0.6.1 | MIT | https://github.com/PoignardAzur/venial |

Godot Engine 4.6.1: MIT. Distribuição oficial: https://godotengine.org/download/archive/4.6.1-stable/.

godot-rust e seus crates próprios usam MPL-2.0 nesta versão. Preservar avisos e cumprir requisitos aplicáveis ao distribuir/modificar esses componentes. Nenhuma dependência foi modificada. Cargo.lock não define a licença do jogo.

Revisão humana de licença é necessária antes de release; não há release nesta entrega.
